# Epigram

> Epigram is a personal news digest app: it fetches the latest stories across
> topics, surfaces related background sources, and generates AI-powered
> insights for them.

This is a dummy placeholder file following the llms-full.txt convention
(https://llmstxt.org). Replace it with real, full-text documentation when the
project has any.

## What it does

- A cron-protected route fetches the latest headlines per topic (business,
  entertainment, general, health, science, sports, technology) via the
  MediaStack API and stores them in Redis.
- For a given query, it finds related background reading with the Exa search
  API.
- It generates concise AI insights for a set of source articles using the
  OpenAI API.
- Stories and insights are cached and rate-limited through Upstash Redis.

## Pages

- `/`: the main feed of today's stories, grouped by topic.
- `/about`: what Epigram is and how it works.
- `/topics`: topic index.

## API routes

- `GET /api/news?categories=<comma,separated,topics>`: cached stories for the
  given categories (defaults to general,technology,science,health).
- `POST /api/news/ai-insights`: request body `{ sources: NewsArticle[] }`;
  returns a streamed AI insight for the given sources (rate-limited).
- `GET /api/news/ai-insights/sources?query=<text>`: related source links for
  a query, found via Exa (rate-limited).
- `GET /api/news/populate`: cron-protected route that refreshes the news
  cache; requires the secret header named by EPIGRAM_SECRET_HEADER_NAME.

## Notes

- All content above is illustrative placeholder text for build purposes.
